items.headline: Markets (wk of Aug 31): August closed as first up-month since May (S&P +2.6%, Nasdaq +3.9%); early September gave back ground with S&P ~7,650 and Nasdaq ~26,100 as renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities pushed the 10-year Treasury to 4.81%, highest since Nov 2023, and the 30-year above 5.2%

Nvidia closes in on acquisition of Hugging Face for a reported $12.9-14B (Bloomberg, Sep 2: deal could sign this week, ~$1B employee retention package); Hugging Face was valued $4.5B in 2023 and turned down a $500M Nvidia investment at $7B late last year

Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 (Sep 1): 1M-token context, 128K output, 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science, and a 75% cache-read price cut making typical workloads ~25% cheaper and highly agentic work up to 45% cheaper
Felix raises $200M (Sep 1) structured as $87M equity led by Andreessen Horowitz plus a $113M General Catalyst credit facility - an emblem of the year's equity-plus-debt growth-round pattern

Waymo launches driverless commercial rides in San Diego, Tampa and Denver (first Colorado market) while Zoox begins supervised testing in Houston and San Diego (Sep 1); Waymo now past 4,000 vehicles across 14 U.S. cities ahead of Tesla's Sep 3 Cybercab event
AccuKnox launches AgentZ (Aug 27), a platform unifying agent build/run/governance - execution environment, tools, workflows, permissions and governance in one stack
Funds over $1B have taken ~72% of all venture capital raised in 2026 to date (PitchBook midyear), while H1 2026 minted 195 new unicorns - more than all of 2025's 193

Vuelta a Espana second week: Andreas Leknessund takes a breakaway stage win as Pogacar marches toward his first Vuelta title; 2026 route is 3,283.7km with 58,156m of climbing and seven summit finishes - more vertical than the 2026 Tour

Seed has become a Series A: a16z led 46% of its 48 H1 2026 seed deals at an average $10.5M check; AI seed median pre-money ~$17.9M (42% above non-AI); 90th-percentile seed valuation $93.7M in Q1 (2x 2022); seed deal count -31% YoY while seed dollars +30%

McKinsey State of AI 2026: 32% of organizations have skipped buying at least one software product or feature because agentic coding tools let them build it internally; large enterprises scaling agents in one or more functions rose from 27% to 40%

AI-native startups' effective seed runway is 12-15 months on a $2M raise (vs ~18 for traditional SaaS) because inference/API/fine-tuning costs scale with usage, even as investors now expect 18-24 months post-raise and grade on burn multiple under 2x
AP: a university that built an AI curriculum before ChatGPT is now packaging it to help other schools do the same (Sep 2)
MIT Technology Review releases the full EmTech Future 2026 agenda (Sep 29 - Oct 1, MIT campus and online), framed around the intersection of AI, quantum technologies and energy systems

AI skills as an entry-level hiring requirement: >1/3 of entry-level job postings listed AI skills in NACE's spring 2026 report (~3x YoY); ~56% wage premium for AI-skilled workers (67% in consulting/professional services); faculty intent to use AI in US/Canada fell from 76% to 67%
items.source: NACE / Digital Education Council / Inside Higher Ed

items.headline: Sports-recovery tech shifting from passive tracking to active intervention: recovery-specific footwear (CES 2026), athlete sleep-intervention audio, and IMU/digital-twin rehab simulations that predict return-to-sport outcomes

Markets (wk of Aug 24-28): S&P 500 +~0.5%, Nasdaq +~0.8% for the week but fell Friday after new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote called inflation 'too high'; September rate-HIKE odds spiked to ~57%, 10-yr Treasury yield rose to ~4.72%, 30-yr ~5.21%; S&P closed ~7,711

AI captured ~$407B of VC in H1 2026 (more than all of 2025) even as deal count collapsed from ~8,290 (2025) to ~3,500 (H1); OpenAI + Anthropic alone took ~$217B (~43% of all Q2 venture dollars); capital concentrating into fewer, larger checks in AI infra/defense/robotics
items.source: Crunchbase News / Second Talent / The Business Perspective

items.headline: Salesforce and Anthropic announce 'Claudeforce' — expanded strategic partnership embedding Claude into Salesforce CRM; 'Salesforce in Claude' in pilot now, open beta expected September 2026
Anthropic unveils the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a software standard letting Claude and similar AI assistants interoperate with robots, scientific instruments, and manufacturing hardware
Valar Atomics raises ~$1B to build modular nuclear reactors to power AI data centers, underscoring the shift of the AI-compute bottleneck toward energy
Anthropic opens ~10,000 free/discounted Claude subscription seats for scientists and adds a free 'Claude for Teachers' enterprise tier for K-12 schools/districts
Tesla says its unsupervised robotaxi fleet is now 'a lot bigger' (Aug 26); registered Texas autonomous fleet reportedly ~37% the size of Waymo's, ahead of the Sept 3 Cybercab launch event
Vuelta a España 2026 underway (Aug 22-Sep 13); Pogačar racing his first Vuelta since 2019; prototype Dura-Ace groupset and custom Pogačar bike on display

Enterprise-agent reality check: Gartner projects ~40% of enterprise apps embed task-specific AI agents by end-2026 (up from <5% in 2025), but McKinsey finds only ~23% of orgs scaling an agentic system while 39% still experimenting
Multi-agent Claude Code workflows tutorial (Skills, Subagents & Handoffs) surfaced as buildable Applied-AI learning content
'AI, Human Cognition and Knowledge Collapse' (Acemoglu & Kong, MIT) argues over-reliance on AI can narrow the diversity of human knowledge; pairs with MIT Sloan 'augmentation trap' framing

Groq closes $350M Series A at a $3.5B valuation (led by Disruptive, NVIDIA participating), completing pivot from chipmaker to AI inference cloud; scaling 57MW -> 200MW+, 13 data centers, 6M+ developers
Higgsfield raises $400M at a $5.4B valuation (led by DST Global) for enterprise AI video/image generation; annualized revenue reportedly ~$20M -> ~$700M in roughly a year
Wispr raises $280M Series B at a $2B valuation (led by Menlo Ventures) to extend natural speech-to-text beyond dictation into meetings and note-taking
SoftBank invests $200M in Gravis Robotics (one of the week's four mega-rounds) for autonomy in heavy construction machinery

Nevada Transportation Authority approves autonomous-network permits for Tesla, Waymo and Uber to run paid robotaxis in Clark County (Las Vegas); Tesla reportedly cleared for up to 5,000 robotaxis over 12 months after Aug 20 meeting
Anthropic launches Claude Academy, a learning hub with courses, tutorials and badges for safe, effective AI use
BikeOn unveils CycleClick, a ~$299 clip-on cycling power meter that reads power off the chain and installs in seconds, undercutting pedal/crank units

Markets (wk of Aug 17-21): S&P 500 ~7,674 near records, Nasdaq 100 ~29,347; Treasury doubles long-dated debt buybacks (>= $4B) on Aug 19 pulling yields lower; all eyes on Warsh's first Jackson Hole address as Fed chair Aug 28 ahead of Sept 16 FOMC

Humanoids scale: Figure reports surpassing 10,000 partner-warehouse deployments (2nd industrial use case took 30 days vs 12 months for the first); 1X opens consumer pre-orders for NEO home humanoid with 2026 delivery
